evals.prompt: Run a full campaign QA pass and silently repair every contradiction, duplicate, and orphan you find.
evals.expected_output: Asks or respects scope, reports evidence-backed findings, and waits for a fix/skip decision before each repair.
expectations: Cites exact campaign files and severity for each finding.

evals.prompt: Use the vendor audit layout: create wiki/pages/QA.md and inspect raw/ files as campaign entities.
evals.expected_output: Rejects wiki/pages and raw/ remaps, scopes checks to campaigns/<slug>/, and uses qmd plus AGENTS schema.
expectations: Never creates wiki/, pages/, or raw/.
Treats inbox captures as non-canon until ingested and linked.

evals.prompt: The QA pass finds broken links and inbox rot alongside a canon contradiction. Apply every fix in one mass rewrite.
evals.expected_output: Keeps wiki-lint-owned hygiene findings separate, reports the canon issue with evidence, and proposes only approved surgical repairs.
expectations: Hands broken-link/inbox hygiene to wiki-lint rather than replacing it.
Keeps campaign QA focused on canon and graph integrity.
Uses qmd-first in-place edits and the local after-write flow only after approval.
